g.title: ERD
g.text: DIAGRAMA COMPLETO DE BASE DE DATOS — PROYECTO EL ALMENDRO

g.title: garantias
g.text: character varying CHECK (estado::text = ANY (ARRAY['ACTIVA'::character varying, 'VENCIDA'::character varying, 'ANULADA'::character varying, 'PENDIENTE'::character varying]::text[]))

g.title: planes_anuales
g.text: character varying CHECK (contexto::text = ANY (ARRAY['CENTRO DE EVENTOS'::character varying, 'HOTEL'::character varying]::text[]))

g.title: pendientes_mantencion
g.text: smallint CHECK (fecha_idea_mes IS NULL OR fecha_idea_mes >= 1 AND fecha_idea_mes <= 12)

character varying CHECK (fecha_idea_precision IS NULL OR (fecha_idea_precision::text = ANY (ARRAY['DIA'::character varying, 'MES'::character varying, 'ANIO'::character varying, 'TEXTO'::character varying]::text[])))
smallint CHECK (fecha_realizado_mes IS NULL OR fecha_realizado_mes >= 1 AND fecha_realizado_mes <= 12)

character varying CHECK (fecha_realizado_precision IS NULL OR (fecha_realizado_precision::text = ANY (ARRAY['DIA'::character varying, 'MES'::character varying, 'ANIO'::character varying, 'TEXTO'::character varying]::text[])))

g.title: administraciones_temporales
g.text: text CHECK (motivo IS NULL OR length(motivo) <= 1000)
